messages:
nim: FYI — FinReg signed for a Q3 private pilot. Requirements: HSM keys, dedicated GPUs, strict network isolation. Can we do a quick dependency map? cc @alex @sam @li

alex: Runtime notes: quant profile must be pinned, persist KV cache, and add a prewarm hook to avoid cold-start spikes. Minor schema change for persistent KV.

sam: Infra: we need 2 racks in their colo, VLAN/NIC isolation, service-account allowlists. Procurement lead-time ~4w. Partner-colo fallback could cut that.

li: Security: HSM integration + audit-log streaming required. Need threat model, rotation policy, and offline import SOP. Gating: infra scans + audit ingestion test.

maria: Product: Minimum launch criteria — 99ms p50 for chat_api, data-at-rest encryption, documented canary + rollback plan. Canary plan: 1% x48h -> 10% x72h -> 100%.

alex: Config sketch:
```
cache.kv_persist=true
cache.warmup_keys=/etc/kv/warmup.txt
runtime.quant_profile=q4_2_v2
```
Also request 2h maintenance window for migration.

sam: Ops runbook and DR playbook needed. I'll estimate partner-colo pricing delta and timeline.

li: I'll add security acceptance criteria to the ticket and own signoff.

ops-bot: Created INF-4921: "FinReg private pilot: infra/runtime/security integration" (assignee: unassigned).

devex-bot: Runbook template available: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/finreg-onprem-template

maria: Next sync 14:00 Wed. Action: owners (Alex/Sam/Li/Maria) update INF-4921 with owners/docs/timeline by COB tomorrow.

nim: Thanks — owners, call out blockers early. If procurement slips, propose partner-colo and note pricing delta to customer.
